SELECT s.id, s.sample_no, s.sample_name, s.client_name, s.task_no, s.inspect_type, s.sampling_date, s.status, s.conclusion, s.confirmed_by, s.audit_by, s.created_at, s.confirmed_at, s.updated_at, s.audit_at FROM sample_info s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status BETWEEN 10 AND 70
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no, s.sample_name, s.client_name, s.task_no, s.inspect_type, s.sampling_date, s.status, s.conclusion, s.audit_by AS audit_by_no, s.audit_at, s.sign_by AS sign_by_no, s.sign_at, s.report_type, s.report_generated_at FROM sample_info s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status IN (80, 90)
AND s.conclusion = #{q.conclusion}
AND s.report_generated_at IS NOT NULL
AND s.report_generated_at IS NULL
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_lib_item i WHERE i.product_lib_id = p.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS item_count FROM product_lib p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.productName}, '%')
AND p.category = #{q.category}
ORDER BY p.id

SELECT i.id AS item_id, s.id AS sample_id, s.sample_no, s.sample_name, s.client_name, s.task_no, i.item_order, i.item_name, i.methods, i.basis_code, i.std_value, i.unit, i.lower_limit, i.judge_type, s.sample_state, s.status AS sample_status, r.conclusion, r.conclusion_source, r.test_value FROM sample_item i JOIN sample_info s ON s.id = i.sample_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sample_result r ON r.sample_item_id = i.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND s.status >= 40
AND i.tester_no = #{q.testerScope}
AND s.sample_no LIKE CONCAT(#{q.sampleNo}, '%')
AND s.sample_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.sampleName}, '%')
AND s.client_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.clientName}, '%')
AND s.task_no = #{q.taskNo}
AND ( r.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(r.test_value, '') = '' AND (i.judge_type <> 3 OR r.conclusion IS NULL OR r.conclusion = 3)) )
ORDER BY s.id, i.item_order
